integrity: Reproducible standalone finite checker and exact mathematical proof provided. Earlier diameter-two ordinary packing chromatic number equality explicitly acknowledged as prior work. No external or independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple graphs with at least two vertices and diameter at most two; ordinary packing radii; integer palettes and nonempty broadcasting partitions. The motivating October 2026 preprint was not completely accessible; equivalent published formulations could exist. Finite checks are not infinite proofs.
title: Packing-domatic coloring polynomials reconstruct independent-set profiles in diameter-two graphs
